newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai govt posts monthly budget surplus in June.
newsitem.headline: Thai govt posts monthly budget surplus in June.

text.p: Thailand posted a 29.5 billion baht ($921.9 million) monthly cash surplus in its operating budget in June after a 4.7 billion baht deficit in May, the finance ministry said on Friday.

The ministry said the June surplus helped narrow government operating budget deficit to 12.0 billion baht during October-June from 41.5 billion in the first eight months of the current 1996/1997 (October-September) fiscal year.

Thailand's sharply slowing economy has reduced government tax revenue. The Bank of Thailand projected in late May that the government will end the current fiscal year with a 23.1 billion baht operating budget deficit against 104.3 billion baht surplus in 1995/1996.
The expected deficit this year would be Thailand's first in 10 years.
